item.title: April in focus: Hong Kong’s Premier Gifts & Home Fairs return
item.description: Global buyers and suppliers will turn their attention to Hong Kong this spring as the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC) presents the 2026 editions of the Hong Kong Gifts & Premium Fair and Home InStyle from April 27 to 30 at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre.

item.title: 'Pocket change': Allbirds sold for a fraction of its former value
item.description: Allbirds has been sold to American Exchange Group for about $39 million, a steep drop from its former multi-billion-dollar valuation.

item.title: Castlery launches first US flagship store in Manhattan’s Chelsea
item.description: Castlery is making its first physical foray into the US market with a flagship store in Manhattan’s Chelsea neighborhood.

item.title: Nike takes ‘meaningful action’ in Q3 despite falling sales
item.description: "The work is not finished, but the direction is clear, our teams are moving with focus and urgency,“ its CEO said.

item.title: How British brand Gymshark conquered the US
item.description: Gymshark’s US growth strategy combines cautious store expansion, influencer marketing, and a community-first approach to long-term brand building.

item.title: Why are pharma firms prioritizing the US first?
item.description: New pricing rules are making the US the key battleground, reshaping how and where drugs are launched.

item.title: RH lifts sales while investments harm margins
item.description: Luxury furniture brand RH, formerly Restoration Hardware, has lifted its sales while heavy investments dent its margins.

item.title: J Jill posts weaker results as sales, margins fall
item.description: J Jill reported weaker fourth-quarter and full-year results, as sales and margins declined despite growth in its direct-to-consumer channel.

item.title: Jollibee expands in New York with third Manhattan location
item.description: Jollibee has opened its third Manhattan store at 14 East 42nd Street, between Fifth and Madison avenues.

item.title: PVH defies tariffs with strong Q4 finish, signals 'steady' 2026
item.description: PVH Corp has reported Q4 results that beat internal guidance, shrugging off tariff headwinds and setting a cautiously optimistic tone for FY26.
